# LineString CSV_WKT Baseline

Canonical baseline LineString stored in a CSV with a WKT column to exercise text-based geometry parsing and CSV_WKT loader behavior.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Case ID | `linestring_csv_wkt_baseline` |
| Category | vector |
| Format | CSV_WKT |
| Geometry type | LineString |
| CRS | `EPSG:4326` |
| Test tier | unit |

| Status | validated |

## What this case checks

Provide a canonical line encoded as CSV_WKT so text-based vector serialization can be compared against file-driver-backed formats.

- [`format_comparison`](../risk/format-comparison.md)
